---
title: "Deadlines"
---

Three assignments and three quizzes (the best two quizzes count). Each assignment deadline is followed by a short
individual viva or quiz.

| Date | Event |
|:--|:--|
| 04 Aug 26 | Course begins |
| 17 Aug 26 | Add-drop period ends |
| 19 Aug 26 | Assignment 1 released |
| 27 Aug 26 | Assignment 1 due |
| 10 Sep 26 | **Quiz 1** |
| 24 Sep 26 | Assignment 2 released |
| 01 Oct 26 | Assignment 2 due |
| 15 Oct 26 | **Quiz 2** |
| 16 Oct 26 | Assignment 3 released |
| 02 Nov 26 | Assignment 3 due |
| 10 Nov 26 | **Quiz 3** |

See [Grading](grading.qmd) for how these count.
